visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a black and white maid costume complete with a white frilly apron, a black bow tie, and cat-ear headband sits at a table. He is in a brightly lit indoor room with modern shelving and recessed ceiling lights. He begins a magic trick using several white dice on a gray textured tablecloth, tossing one into the air and catching it skillfully. (2) As the man continues his performance, his facial expression remains focused and slightly playful. He wears black lace fingerless gloves. He manipulates multiple dice, gathering them into a small pile while looking directly into the camera. A large graphic logo for 'SQUID GAME' is superimposed over his chest area throughout the sequence. (3) The scene undergoes a sudden visual shift where the indoor background is replaced by a bright digital background of a blue sky with soft white clouds and glowing sunbeams radiating from behind him. He completes the trick by throwing a handful of dice towards the camera lens, creating a sense of three-dimensional motion as they appear to float near the viewer.
